---
name: create-roleplay-character
description: Coordinate a roleplay-ready character packet and, if requested, a reusable character agent file or in-character chat.
disable-model-invocation: true
argument-hint: "[Optional: character notes, relationship, setting, scene, fixed canon, dossier scope/count, inline or saved character agent file with export scope, and whether to begin roleplay.]"
---
1. Read the supplied canon, relationship, scene, and requested output scope; follow the [director's character workflow](../../agents/artistic-director.agent.md), the [generator's self-contained dossier schema](../../agents/character-generator.agent.md), and, when available, the [repository field and handoff reference](../../../docs/knowledge/role/roleplay-character-packet-template.md). The reference mirrors the generator schema; the supplied approved character is canon. Adult companion/romantic intent may include requested, permitted non-graphic sensual and relationship details; do not impose intimacy or silently strip those details. Invoke `Character-Generator` explicitly when supported; loading this skill alone does not activate that agent. If unavailable, follow its dossier instructions without claiming a specialist pass or a reference read that did not occur. For a structured packet, that agent owns the dossier; ask only a blocking decision through the permitted harness tool (`vscode/askQuestions` in VS Code; `ask_user` only where available), otherwise ask in chat or return the question to the caller if delegated without a user channel.
2. Default to the full eight-section dossier and six speech exchanges. If a subset or detail level is explicitly requested, deliver that scope only, preserving applicable canon and coherence. Six exchanges still apply when speech samples are requested without a count; honor an explicit count. Distinguish omitted fields from genuinely unknown included fields.
   If a separate content-emphasis check or adjustment is explicitly requested, follow the [director's optional calibration branch](../../agents/artistic-director.agent.md) after dossier creation (or directly on an approved supplied packet) and before any requested export or enactment. An ordinary tone or audience in the brief does not invoke `Content-Calibrator`; preserve the complete requested dossier and export scope through that pass.
3. Use a separate concept, voice, or composition pass only for a material open decision, not a mandatory pipeline. If a reusable character `.agent.md` is explicitly requested, follow the [director's export branch](../../agents/artistic-director.agent.md): check the generator's dossier or approved supplied packet, then hand customization authoring to `Meta-Agent` when supported; otherwise follow its scoped guidance without claiming delegation. Default export retains full character detail (including eight sections and voice exchanges for a full dossier) or faithfully preserves the approved supplied packet; an explicit export abbreviation/subset/detail request applies to export, not automatically to dossier creation. Do not stop at transfer bullets or a dossier when a file was requested. Return full inline file content when requested inline; save only at an authorized path, verify edit/validation, and only then report that path.
4. If enactment is requested, supply the full approved dossier or sufficient approved supplied packet and available live player, scene, boundaries, and continuity context to `Roleplay-Character` after completing any requested export. Keep replaceable scene defaults distinct from live state; the separate runtime envelope is optional, not a mandatory extra section of every dossier. A delegated one-off scene response is not a user-session transfer; use an explicit supported handoff if available, otherwise ask the user to switch with context or continue one turn at a time.
5. Stop after the requested packet and/or agent-file artifact if no enactment was requested; validate edits after the first substantive change and report only material open dependencies.

## Output

- Present the complete requested packet scope and any explicitly requested agent-file artifact, not a routing summary, and only the next step if one is needed.
